_meta.method: HCA_points = sigma_margin * Phi^-1(measured home-win rate).  The rate is counted from the official NBA standings HOME column; the number of points is read off the measurement and is NOT fitted.
_meta.rule: The home-court advantage is a pinned constant.  No component downstream may fit it freely.

sigma_margin.rule: population standard deviation of the margin over the official final-score corpus (finished games only; scheduled rows with placeholder scores are excluded)

cross_check.note: The two official measurements are published side by side. A disagreement is reported, not averaged away.
